title: CanonicalGroundTruthSchema
description: Schema for machine-curated and human-verified canonical document structure ground truth in Novela benchmark corpus.

document_id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark document (e.g. 001_middlemarch)

source_file.description: Filename of the source PDF in validation/Corpus

edition_notes.description: Edition-specific metadata, publisher, year, or visual notes on the source PDF

human_verified.description: Must be false until actual human review has been conducted across the document

verification_coverage.description: Summary of verification scope (e.g. candidate_machine_curated, human_verified_partial, human_verified_full)

structural_notes.description: Edition-specific structural notes and discrepancies from generic reference editions

scored_levels.description: Structural levels actively evaluated in current benchmark metrics (e.g. ['volume', 'book'])

deferred_levels.description: Structural levels recognized in the work but deferred from active scoring (e.g. ['chapter'])

benchmark_status.description: Operational status of this document within the automated benchmark runner

nodes.description: Hierarchical list of canonical structural nodes present in this edition

node_id.description: Deterministic identifier for the node (e.g. node_vol1_bk2)

parent_id.description: node_id of the parent structural node, or null for top-level nodes

title.description: Canonical title or heading label expected in the document

type.description: Structural type (e.g. volume, book, chapter, letter, preface, introduction, epilogue, front_matter, back_matter, apparatus, note)

level.description: Hierarchy level depth (1 for Volume/Part, 2 for Book/Letter, 3 for Chapter, etc.)

order.description: Sequential reading order index in the document

page_start.description: 1-indexed starting PDF page number if known or candidate

page_end.description: 1-indexed ending PDF page number if known or candidate

subtitles.description: Optional subtitles or descriptive titles associated with the heading

verification_status.description: Verification status of this specific node

verification_notes.description: Detailed notes on how the node was identified, ambiguous aspects, or review guidance

benchmark_status.description: Whether this specific node is evaluated in current benchmark metrics
